Free Image Creator 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly generate AI images and 1080p videos from your text prompts—no sliders or complex controls.
- Simple workflow: upload, describe, and get downloadable content complete with cloud GPU rendering pipeline.
- Supports multiple formats (JPG, PNG, WEBP, MP4, and more); upload files up to 200MB.
- Auto-connects and manages authentication (anonymous tokens, session handling).
- Shows timeline summaries for edits and supports quick, batch, and iterative content creation.
- Clear feedback and robust error handling for missing tokens, credits, or file issues.
